evals.prompt: Build me a SaaS dashboard with a sidebar, some stat cards, a couple of charts, and a data table. React and Tailwind.
evals.expected_output: Claude should first generate an ASCII wireframe showing the dashboard layout with explicit proportions, labeled sections, sample data in the table, and chart types — before writing any code. Then iterate if needed, then build.

evals.prompt: Create a landing page for my AI writing tool called Drafter. I want a hero section, features, pricing with 3 tiers, and a footer. Make it modern.
evals.expected_output: Claude should produce an ASCII wireframe showing hero layout (split vs full-width), exact number of feature columns, pricing card structure with tier names, and footer layout — all before writing any HTML/CSS. Proportions and hierarchy should be explicit.

evals.prompt: I need an n8n workflow: webhook receives a lead, validate it, look up in HubSpot, check score, route to sales or nurture sequence.
evals.expected_output: Claude should draw an ASCII flowchart showing ALL branches including error/invalid paths, not-found cases, and symmetric endings — before generating any workflow JSON. Every decision point and edge case should be visible.
